description: Screenshot of a tweet by journalist Paul Sperry (@paulsperry_) claiming that neither Robert Mueller nor John Huber has interviewed Bruce Ohr, and questioning how effective U.S. Attorney John Huber can be at investigating alleged FISA abuses from Salt Lake City. The timestamp line at the bottom is partially cropped (August 2018).
text: Paul Sperry. @paulsperry_. Mueller hasn't interviewed Bruce Ohr, but apparently JOHN HUBER hasn't either, even though Huber was tapped by Sessions to investigate the FISA abuses. More reason to wonder how effective a US attorney can be cleaning up corruption in Washington when he's based in Salt Lake City. 10:05 AM - Aug 2_, 2018
flags: Tweet's claims about who has or has not been interviewed are unverified
Timestamp partially cropped; exact day uncertain
